intro.vo: Recording your expenses. Four simple steps.

beats.caption: Hatua 1: Fungua Matumizi kutoka Menyu
beats.vo: Step one. Open the menu and tap expenses.

beats.caption: Hatua 3: Chagua aina, andika maelezo, bei na idadi
beats.vo: Step three. Choose a category, describe the expense, then enter the price and quantity.

beats.caption: Hatua 4: Hifadhi na uone kwenye orodha
beats.vo: Step four. Save it, and it appears in your list.

endCard.title: Sasampa POS
endCard.subtitle: Tazama mafunzo mengine.
endCard.vo: That is all. Watch our other tutorials to learn more.
